# Translations for `tracy-business/j6` **1.2.3**

Copied byte for byte from [`../1.2.2/`](../1.2.2/README.md) (`MANIFEST.sha256` unchanged and still matching).

Why a copy is right: 1.2.3 is 1.2.2 with three template stylesheets repaired and tokenized again
(tracy-ds-slot `release-joomla.mjs`, readiness 13/10/2026, TracyHQ/tch#1318). The database asset is the
same bytes as 1.2.2's and the content map is identical, so no field was added, removed or renamed and
the translations joined by key keep their meaning.
